question: What destructive power and mobile presence are affirmed of the deity?
premises: The deity is a great slayer
The deity wanders on many ridges
inference: The deity combines destructive force with pervasive, mobile presence.
uncertainties: naika+sānu+carāya may also suggest having many attendants
plain_english: Obeisance to the great slayer; obeisance to the one who wanders on many ridges; obeisance to the moving one.
